transcript:
Speaker A (Female Voiceover): पति की ऑफिस पार्टी में HR ने पूछा, 'So, what do you do?' मैं बोली, 'I... home... काम...' HR मुस्कुराई और किसी और से बात करने लग गई। पति पास में खड़ा था। घर तक गाड़ी में कोई नहीं बोला। वो साइलेंस जिंदगी की सबसे भारी इंसल्ट थी... [At my husband's office party, the HR asked, 'So, what do you do?' I said, 'I... home... work...' The HR smiled and started talking to someone else. My husband was standing nearby. No one spoke in the car on the way home. That silence was the biggest insult of my life...]
Speaker B (HR): Hi, you must be Rahul's wife. So nice to finally meet you. What do you do?
Speaker A (as character): I... home... काम... घर में... [I... home... work... at home...]
Speaker B (HR): Oh, that's nice.
Speaker A (Voiceover): HR मुस्कुराई और दूसरे कपल से बात करने लग गई। बॉस की वाइफ आती है। [The HR smiled and started talking to another couple. The boss's wife comes over.]
Speaker C (Boss's Wife): Hi dear, where are you from?
Speaker A (as character): मैं... जयपुर... से... [I... from Jaipur...]
Speaker C (Boss's Wife): Oh lovely! Jaipur is beautiful. Do you work or...
Speaker A (Voiceover): मेरा चुप। पति आता है। [I was silent. My husband comes.]
Speaker D (Husband): Sorry, she's a bit tired today.
Speaker A (Voiceover): घर जाते वक्त गाड़ी में साइलेंस। [Silence in the car on the way home.]
Speaker D (Husband): आज अच्छा था पार्टी में? [Was it good at the party today?]
Speaker A (Voiceover): हां, कोई और बात नहीं। दोनों चुप। उस रात सब सो गए, मैं बाथरूम में बैठकर रोई। सुंदर हूं, सब कहते हैं। पर सुंदर होने से क्या होता है जब मुंह से एक वर्ड नहीं निकले। शादी की क्योंकि प्रीटी थी, पर पार्टी में प्रीटी से काम नहीं चलता, इंग्लिश चाहिए। उस रात फोन उठाया, इंग्लिश सीखो ऐप डाउनलोड किया। ₹1 का ट्रायल था। जनरल इंग्लिश शो खोला। 'हेलो' से बात शुरू करें, 1 लाख से ज्यादा लोग देख चुके थे। प्ले किया, इतना सिंपल था कि मुझे लगा हां, ये मैं कर सकती हूं। रोज रात को पति सो जाता, मैं फोन पर सीखती। अपने बारे में बताओ: 'My name is Meera. I am from Jaipur. I am a homemaker.' नाम और सिटी कॉन्फिडेंटली बोले। अपना नाम और सिटी इंग्लिश में कॉन्फिडेंटली बोलना। अपनी फैमिली इंट्रोड्यूस करें: 'My husband works at Infosys. We have been married for one year.' AI कोच से प्रैक्टिस करती थी। 'Hi, nice to meet you. I am Meera. I am from Jaipur. I manage our home. I love cooking and reading.' गलत बोलती, सुधार देती। 500 बार गलत बोला, 500 बार सुधारा। कभी नहीं बोली, 'होममेकर है, तुझे इंग्लिश की क्या जरूरत?' 3 महीने बाद दिवाली पार्टी थी ऑफिस की। पति ने बोला, 'चलना है?' मैंने बोला, 'हां'। [Yes, nothing else. Both silent. That night everyone slept, I sat in the bathroom and cried. Everyone says I am beautiful. But what is the use of being beautiful when not a single word comes out of your mouth. He married me because I was pretty, but being pretty doesn't work at a party, you need English. That night I picked up my phone, downloaded the English Seekho app. There was a 1-rupee trial. Opened the General English show. 'Start talking with Hello', more than 1 lakh people had watched it. Played it, it was so simple that I felt yes, I can do this. Every night when my husband slept, I learned on my phone. Tell about yourself: 'My name is Meera. I am from Jaipur. I am a homemaker.' Spoke name and city confidently. Introduce your family: 'My husband works at Infosys. We have been married for one year.' I practiced with the AI coach. 'Hi, nice to meet you. I am Meera. I am from Jaipur. I manage our home. I love cooking and reading.' If I spoke wrong, it corrected me. Spoke wrong 500 times, corrected 500 times. It never said, 'You are a homemaker, why do you need English?' 3 months later, it was the office Diwali party. My husband asked, 'Want to go?' I said, 'Yes'.]
Speaker E (Colleague): Meera, so good to see you again! How have you been?
Speaker A (as character): I have been great, thank you. We recently went to Udaipur for our anniversary. The Lake Palace was absolutely beautiful. Have you been there?
Speaker E (Colleague): Oh wow! No, I haven't. You have to tell me more!
Speaker A (Voiceover): पति दूर से देख रहा था। बॉस आया, बोला, 'Rahul, your wife is very charming.' घर जाते वक्त गाड़ी में पति ने हाथ पकड़ा, बोला, 'आज मुझे प्राउड फील हुआ।' मैंने बोला, 'इंग्लिश सीखो ऐप, रोज 15 मिनट, बस इतना।' इंग्लिश सीखो ऐप डाउनलोड करो, जनरल इंग्लिश शो खोलो, AI कोच से प्रैक्टिस करो। ₹1 का ट्रायल है। अगली पार्टी में चुप मत बैठना, बोलो कॉन्फिडेंटली। पति का चेहरा देखना तब। [My husband was watching from afar. The boss came and said, 'Rahul, your wife is very charming.' On the way home in the car, my husband held my hand and said, 'Today I felt proud.' I said, 'English Seekho app, 15 minutes daily, just that.' Download the English Seekho app, open the General English show, practice with the AI coach. There is a 1-rupee trial. Don't sit silent at the next party, speak confidently. See your husband's face then.]
Speaker F (Male Voiceover): तो इंस्टॉल बटन पर क्लिक करो और इंग्लिश सीखो ऐप डाउनलोड करो। [So click on the install button and download the English Seekho app.]
